thread.title: Amazon's stock gains premarket, positions for longest win streak in 5 years

author: morningstar.com
title: Amazon's stock gains premarket, positions for longest win streak in 5 years
text:
Shares of Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) edged up 0.1% in premarket trade Wednesday, which puts them in position for a 10th-straight gain, in the aftermath of a successful Prime Day sales event (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/amazon-says-us-prime-day-sales-reach-records-despite-early-outage-2018-07-17), despite early technical troubles. A 10-day win streak would be the longest since the 10-day stretch ending July 12, 2013. In between, there were three nine-day win streaks, two earlier this year and the other in 2014. During the current streak, which included five-straight record closes, the stock had run up $149.97, or 8.9%, over the past nine sessions, to add about $72.8 billion to the e-commerce giant's market capitalization. Amazon's market cap at Tuesday's close was $894.7 billion, to rank second in the U.S. behind Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) $941.0 billion. Amazon shares have shot up 57% year to date through Tuesday, while Apple's stock has climbed 13% and the S&P 500 has gained 5.1%.
-Tomi Kilgore; 0900ET
